name: manual_fee265
claim: When a security scanner first fails on a synthetic PR merge, compare the merge-parent delta and inspect the exact rule before changing controls; keep the enforcement intact and narrow the remediation to the verified triggering text or behavior.

decisions.notes: Observed while repairing the PR #459 CI failure introduced through the origin/main side of synthetic merge 50cc71f3be64eb40f69b428d6d470609c404b2ce. The credential rule matched terms across a historical document, not a live bearer leak; the durable repair kept fail-closed HTTPS enforcement and corrected only the ambiguous wire-level wording.
